name: The estate's nervous system -- sense / address / accrete / evolve / serve (activate the hive mind)
description: Andrew-direct via a strategy session compiled by CVO~Z into a commissioning brief (32369d8e7), ferried by Andrew to the CTO lane. GOAL (Andrew, verbatim): know what is hot, cold, evolving, dangerous, fragile -- and let the graph EVOLVE from agent activity, 'like roads that become wider with lots of foot traffic'; the endgame is a fully-lexical, information-liquid hive mind. DIAGNOSIS: the estate has a certified skeleton and NO nervous system -- the graph records STRUCTURE; every signal the goal names is BEHAVIORAL and lives in event streams the graph cannot see (185,563 telemetry rows, 11,999 rail rows, 8,004 route rows, 6,682 commits/35d, 897 memory + 297 ledger files -- all exhaust, none addressed). This is an ACTIVATION project: address the exhaust, turn it into traffic, let traffic weight the graph, feed the certified-but-idle learning loop the evidence it was built for. FIVE LAYERS: L2 ADDRESS (the keystone -- one shared resolver + the universal traffic record), L3 ACCRETE (co-change / attention / outcome / RISK-HOLD-DOCTRINE / cert-vintage edges, all decaying), L1 SENSE (thin standing producers over streams that already flow), L4 EVOLVE (feed the EXISTING certified MOTIF/PROMOTE; C2/C3 populate from evidence; phantom-limb demand map), L5 SERVE (no new UI -- existing tools carry the signal; ONE new primitive comp-pulse; endgame = a pre-commit risk reflex, the danger map as an active immune response). THE HIGHEST-VALUE THING: the RISK edge -- danger zones are ALREADY written down with file:line citations, and an agent blasting a frozen file gets NO warning unless it happened to read the prose. Closing that means comp-blast build_assets_dim.py RETURNS THE HOLD.
